items.prompt: If you ___ too much coffee, you often can't sleep.

explanation.en: Zero conditional: present simple in both clauses.

optionNotes.en: Correct: present simple for a general truth.
Will does not go in the if clause.
Would does not go in the if clause.

items.prompt: I'll text you as soon as the plane ___.

explanation.en: After as soon as, use the present simple for the future.
explanation.es: Tras as soon as, presente: as soon as the plane lands.

optionNotes.en: Correct: present simple for the future.
Will cannot follow as soon as.

items.prompt: If you ___ that cake, Mum will be furious.

explanation.en: First conditional: present simple after if.

optionNotes.en: Will does not go after if.
Would does not go after if.

items.prompt: You can't board the plane ___ you show your passport at the gate.

explanation.es: Unless = «a menos que»: el verbo no lleva negación.

optionNotes.en: Correct: you won't get a refund if you don't have it.
If would make the sentence say the opposite.
When does not express a condition here.

items.prompt: We'll go ahead with the launch when everyone ___ approved the design.

explanation.en: In time clauses, use the present perfect, not will.
explanation.es: Con when, presente: when everyone has approved.

optionNotes.en: Would does not fit a real future.
